title: cerastium cerastoides
intro: Cerastium cerastoides, commonly known as the pin-cushion mouse-ear or rock jasmine, is a perennial plant species belonging to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium cerastoides include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress, and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in herbal teas and infusions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential antioxidant and anti-cancer activities.
